# v0.5.0 plan — UDAP JWT client authentication and B2B client_credentials

Milestone: [v0.5.0](https://github.com/vanessuniq/safire/milestone/1) ·
Issues: #338 (Authentication Token), #339 (B2B client_credentials),
#340 (release prep), #332, #333 · Decisions: [decisions.md](decisions.md)

## Reconciliation with existing work

| Roadmap / backlog item | State at plan time (`main` 5ac7e77) | Action |
|---|---|---|
| UDAP registration wildcard enforcement (breaking) | Implemented, unreleased (CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]`) | Ship in v0.5.0; no new code |
| PKCE non-String verifier fix | Implemented, unreleased | Ship in v0.5.0 |
| #332 wildcard wording | Draft PR #335 (other session) | Reuse; stack 5.6 on it |
| #333 release skill markers | Draft PR #336 (other session) | Reuse; merged at integration |
| UDAP Authentication Tokens | Not implemented (`Udap` raises `NotImplementedError`) | Tasks 5.1, 5.2 |
| B2B client_credentials | Not implemented; `UdapMetadata` already parses token metadata | Tasks 5.3–5.11 |

## Scope

In: AnT construction; `hl7-b2b` extension; client_credentials token request via
`Client#request_backend_token` on `protocol: :udap`; discovery readiness;
scope negotiation for token requests; demo workflow; docs; release prep.
Out (later versions): authorization code, refresh, Tiered OAuth, SMART scope
fallback removal (v0.6.0 breaking change must not land here).

| # | Concern | Branch | Base | Acceptance (spec basis) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5.1 | Signing identity (refactor) | `refactor/udap-signing-credentials` | main | Software statements unchanged (all existing specs pass unedited); shared key/chain/alg/x5c handling (general.md §7.1.2–7.1.3) |
| 5.2 | AnT builder | `feature/udap-authentication-token` | 5.1 | `iss`=`sub`=client_id; `aud`=token endpoint exact; `exp-iat`=300 ≤ 300 [N b2b §5.2.1]; fresh `jti` [N §7.1.4]; header `alg`+`x5c` [N §7.1.3]; `extensions` only when given, JSON objects |
| 5.3 | `hl7-b2b` model | `feature/udap-b2b-authorization-extension` | main | Required `organization_id` URI, `purpose_of_use` ≥1; `version` "1"; `consent_reference` only with `consent_policy` [N b2b §5.2.1.1] |
| 5.4 | Token response parsing (refactor) | `refactor/shared-token-response-parsing` | main | SMART unchanged; parser shared |
| 5.6 | Scope negotiation (refactor + `:token` op) | `refactor/udap-scope-negotiation` | #335 | Registration/cancel unchanged; `:token` enforces wildcard rule [N general §7.3 item 3] |
| 5.9 | Integration | `integration/v0.5.0` | 5.6 | Merge-only; full suite + RuboCop green |
| 5.7 | Discovery readiness | `feature/udap-token-readiness` | 5.9 | D-09 checks with ADR-015 classification [N discovery §2.2, §2.3] |
| 5.10 | Request + response + facade | `feature/udap-b2b-client-credentials` | 5.7 | POST form: `grant_type=client_credentials`, `scope` (required), `client_assertion_type`, `client_assertion`, `udap=1`; no `Authorization` header or secret [N b2b §5.2.2]; AnT includes `extensions.hl7-b2b` [N §5.2.1]; errors → `TokenError` with OAuth codes; docs page |
| 5.11 | Demo | `feature/demo-udap-b2b-token` | 5.10 | Demo can request a B2B token with configured client_id, scopes, `hl7-b2b`; error paths visible; specs |
| 5.12 | Release notes | `docs/v0.5.0-release-notes` | 5.11 | CHANGELOG `[Unreleased]`, ROADMAP, README, compatibility table, gemspec description accurate |

## Not verifiable locally

- Interoperability with a real UDAP authorization server (no reachable UDAP
  test server; udap.org test tools blocked). All UDAP token tests are WebMock
  based. **No external UDAP conformance claim is made.**
- Trust-community semantics (allowed URI schemes, NPI/NUCC vocabularies).
